pricing_source: User-provided Pasted markdown.md public pricing snapshot
price_precision: Published precision retained; unknown values are blank/null, never zero
taxes: GST excluded; rate not independently verified
billing_notes: Hourly, quarterly, yearly, and 3-year prices are kept separate as published.
Quarterly monthly equivalent is derived as quarterly total / 3 and is not a provider monthly tariff.
Snapshot states powered-off VMs remain billable; stop alone gives INR 0 cash savings.
Reserved public IP tariff is unverified and stored blank.
AMD disk size/bundling is unknown; disk_gb blank for AMD plans rather than inferred.
Region-specific tariffs are unverified; region labels are synthetic deployment locations.

metrics.metrics_only_for: VM metrics cover VMs; GPU telemetry is separately stored in gpu_metrics.csv; volumes and IPs have inventory/relationship/events only

metric_semantics.cpu_utilization_pct: synthetic percentage of allocated vCPU capacity used
metric_semantics.memory_utilization_pct: synthetic percentage of allocated RAM in use; simulator convention, not a provider-specific cache policy
metric_semantics.estimated_cpu_demand_cores: derived = vCPU * cpu_utilization_pct / 100; not directly measured
metric_semantics.estimated_memory_demand_gib: derived = RAM GiB * memory_utilization_pct / 100; not directly measured
metric_semantics.network_in_mbps/network_out_mbps: synthetic throughput rates in megabits per second
metric_semantics.quality_flag: observed_synthetic or missing_observation; missing values remain null

billing_history.growth_pattern: synthetic +8 percentage points per month; month 6 is +40% vs baseline

test_oracle: Expected detections are in test_oracle.csv and must never be passed to the recommendation engine.
injected_anomalies: vm-001: 24-hour CPU and network spike, day 18 at 10:00 through day 19 at 10:00
vm-002: 6-hour disk IOPS spike, day 27 at 02:00 through day 27 at 08:00

storage_pricing.object_storage_formula: 500 INR/month includes 100 GB; +4 INR/GB/month above 100 GB

caveat: Only pricing is transcribed from supplied snapshot; workload telemetry and resource relationships are synthetic.
